name: Sky view factor
description: How much of the sky the ground sees past the buildings, terrain and woods around it, from 0 at the foot of a shaft to 1 on open land.

classify.title: Sky view factor
classify.note: 1 − mean sin² of the horizon in 32 directions within 150 m (Johnson & Watson 1984; Zakšek et al. 2011), past buildings, terrain and woods (FAO forest: over 0.5 ha, trees over 5 m); single trees do not block.
